risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection Risks
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions cybersecurity as a major risk in Item 1A. The company has implemented a comprehensive risk management program based on the NIST CSF, but ongoing exposure to threats justifies a high severity rating. The company did not report any material incidents in 2023-2025.

risks.title: Volatility and Pace of Change in the Global Environment
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly emphasizes that volatility, risk, and the pace of change in the global operating environment will continue to increase, as stated in the Next Phase 2024-2030 section. This risk is presented as a key factor requiring rapid adaptation.

risks.title: Dependence on the ITW Business Model and Its Processes
risks.score_rationale: The ITW business model (80/20 Front-to-Back, customer-driven innovation, decentralized culture) is presented as the fundamental source of value creation and primary competitive advantage. Failure to maintain effective execution would impair performance.

risks.title: Portfolio Management and Asset Divestitures
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions portfolio management initiatives including targeted acquisitions and divestitures. In 2024, it sold its stake in Wilsonart for $398M, realizing a gain of $363M. The selection and integration of acquisitions carry execution risks.

risks.title: Customer-Driven Innovation and Solution Development
risks.score_rationale: Customer-back Innovation is identified as the most impactful driver to achieve high-quality organic growth in the Next Phase. Failure to understand and solve critical customer problems could hinder growth.

risks.title: Execution of the Next Phase Organic Growth Strategy
risks.score_rationale: The Next Phase strategy 2024-2030 aims to make organic growth a core strength on par with ITW's global financial performance. Achieving this ambitious goal depends on disciplined execution and continuous adaptation.

ai_positioning.summary: There is no significant mention of artificial intelligence in the provided 10-K document.
